semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: Knowledge base question answering falls under the broader category of question answering methodologies. While knowledge base question answering specifically uses structured data from knowledge bases, it is essentially a subdomain of question answering.

parent_domains.justification: Question answering is a broad domain under which different types like open-domain, knowledge base, and others reside. Hence, it acts as a parent domain for knowledge base question answering.

The processes involved in knowledge base question answering often encompass elements of knowledge representation and reasoning because they involve structured data and using such data to derive answers.
Knowledge bases in question answering are often represented as knowledge graphs; thus, knowledge graphs serve as a parent domain for systems based on knowledge bases.

closest_parent_domain.justification: As the base field under which all types of question answering, including knowledge base question answering, are categorized, 'question answering' acts as the closest parent domain.

child_domains.justification: Open-domain question answering is an extension of the concept, leveraging knowledge bases for answering questions without restrictions on the domain, thus it can be more specific relative to simple knowledge base question answering.

Though broader, explainable question answering often uses frameworks derived from knowledge base question answering to provide detailed reasoning, serving as a potential subfield of the broader category depending on system setup.

closest_child_domain.justification: Open-domain question answering is more specific to the ability to work with knowledge bases in answering unrestricted questions, lying closely under the broader category of knowledge base question answering.

sibling_domains.justification: Both open-domain and knowledge base question answering serve different but closely related purposes within the broader question answering domain.
Visual question answering involves interpreting and understanding non-textual data for answering questions, a diverse approach under the larger question answering umbrella.
While distinct in its use of unstructured data, it lies within the broader scope of question answering research and shares alignment with knowledge base responses to questions.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: This represents a type closely aligned with knowledge base methods in structure and application but with a broader domain application emphasis.

unrelated_domains.justification: Although it deals with language understanding, it specializes in inference instead of question-answering directly.
While it transforms language into a machine-readable format and acts as an aid, it is a distinct domain from question answering.
Information retrieval covers a range of topics including locating documents, which may contribute to answering questions but functions independently from knowledge base question answering.
It is primarily involved in identifying entities within text, which may serve as inputs or tools but is not directly tied to knowledge base QA processes.
Encompasses a broad set separate from the direct application of knowledge-base-driven question answering methodologies.
